name: Hotel Désirée
beschreibung: Hotel Désirée is situated in a tranquil natural setting within the Tyrolean Alps. The surrounding mountain panorama provides an extensive network of hiking trails in summer and direct connections to regional ski resorts during winter. Guest amenities include a wellness area complete with sauna and relaxation room, alongside a restaurant serving authentic regional dishes. All rooms feature balconies with picturesque mountain vistas, making it an excellent retreat for outdoor enthusiasts and relaxation seekers alike.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Désirée offers relaxing alpine accommodation in the Tyrolean Alps, featuring a wellness sauna area, regional dining, and easy access to hiking and ski areas.
